values.body:
**CRITICAL · security** — the refresh token is written to the request log

Anyone with log access can replay a session.

**Fix:** redact `token` before logging.

Evidence: src/auth.ts:42

<!-- yama:finding:auth-token-logged -->

content.raw:
**MAJOR · crypto** — password hashing uses a single unsalted round

A leaked table is trivially reversible.

Evidence: src/tokens.ts:17

<!-- yama:finding:weak-hash -->

values.body: Disagree on the last one — `formatUser` is in the legacy module we are deleting next sprint, so duplicating it here is deliberate. Please stop raising duplication against `src/legacy/**`.
Good catch on the token logging, fixed in 3f1a2b.
